# Twenty Minds Decision Engine — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Adversarial 20-perspective decision CLI + interactive web demo. The web demo runs the real manual-backend protocol in-browser, parity-verified against the Python CLI. $0, stdlib-only, no network calls, no telemetry.

## Machine facts
- registry_slug: cwi-twenty-minds
- type: app (app = standalone product site; gear = licensable Agent Deck SKU)
- live_url: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-twenty-minds/
- data_truth: LIVE  (LIVE = live-verified facts · SAMPLE = sample/seed data, never presented as verified · MIXED = labeled per-section)
- status: live
- category: pending
- tags: pending
- agent_card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-twenty-minds/.well-known/agent-card.json

- repo: CumulativeWebInc/cwi-twenty-minds
- per_product_llms: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/registry/cwi-twenty-minds/llms.txt

## Capabilities
- 20 named adversarial perspectives, one verdict + one risk each
- distinctness guard (exact / >=0.90 Jaccard)
- mandatory-dissent synthesis
- report.md + report.json (schema 1.0.0)
- per-mind model routing (CLI)

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-twenty-minds/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
